body: Genting Malaysia (GENM MK) +ve on new Genting Casino but not enough to move the needle Impact of new mass gaming floor minor, in our view We are positive that GENM has opened another mass gaming floor. Yet, it is nowhere near the size of the Circus Palace and Hollywood mass gaming floors which remain closed for renovations. Thus, we refrain from raising our earnings estimates and DCF-TP. Nonetheless, we continue to believe that GENM’s valuations are attractive. Key risks are more related party transactions involving Empire Resorts and negative outcome from its USD600m lawsuit by RAV Bahamas (Not Listed). Circus Palace and Hollywood remain closed… We visited Resorts World Genting (RWG) on 30 Dec 2024 after hearing talks that the Circus Palace and Hollywood mass gaming floors have reopened. Recall that they were closed for renovation in Feb 2024. Alas, both mass gaming floors remain closed although it does appear to us that renovations are underway. GENM informed us that they will reopen eventually but a date has not been set yet. Instead, there were signs pointing us to another mass gaming floor called Genting Casino. … but another mass gaming floor opens The other Genting Casino is divided over 2 areas with 2 themes. 1 is similar to Sky Casino while the other is traditional Chinese. It has a lot of lower yielding slot machines and electronic tables but we understand that margins are higher as fewer staff are required. Only 36 conventional tables were deployed. Minimum table bets ranged from MYR10 to MYR100. There were no smoking lounges which is negative for length of play as gamblers have to leave the casino to smoke. BAU at Sky Casino with new smoking lounges Over at Sky Casino, we notice that the crowd was thin as the year end school holidays had just ended. Minimum table bets ranged from MYR25 to MYR100. It appears to us that most conventional tables that were placed on the first floor before have been replaced with lower yielding but higher margin slot machines and electronic tables to manage staff costs post- peak season. Positively, there were smoking lounges as this will not force gamblers to leave the casino to smoke. body: Q1, 2025, forex gain sungguh ajaib..Notwithstanding the Group’s performance in 4Q24, the Group’s total revenue for FY24 grew by 7% to RM10,911.8 million while adjusted EBITDA increased by 11% to RM2,910.4 million, factoring in net unrealised foreign exchange translation gains, mainly on the Group’s USD denominated borrowings. Excluding the impact of the net unrealised foreign exchange translation gains of RM115.4 million as compared to net unrealised foreign exchange translation losses of RM171.1 million in the same period last year (FY23), the Group’s adjusted EBITDA would be relatively flat at RM2,795.0 million. However, the Group registered lower profit before taxation (PBT) by 28% to RM486.7 million, while net profit declined by 55% to RM162.1 million in FY24. These were mainly due to the impact of the net unrealised foreign exchange translation, exceptional items, higher pre-opening expenses in relation to the Group’s participation in the New York Gaming Facility Board's Request for Applications, and higher financing costs. Excluding the effect of the unrealised foreign exchange translation and the impact of exceptional items, which include property, plant and equipment (“PPE”) written off and net gain on disposal of PPE, the Group’s PBT would be lower by 14% to RM585.8 million and the Group would have reported a 29% decline in net profit to RM261.2 million.

author: Good123
body: FY24 Operating Results Total revenue from the Group’s leisure and hospitality operations grew by 7% to RM10,698.7 million while adjusted EBITDA marginally improved by 1% to RM2,920.3 million. In Malaysia, the Group’s leisure and hospitality operations reported a 6% growth in revenue to RM6,823.0 million while adjusted EBITDA marginally increased by 1% to RM2,092.2 million. These improvements were mainly attributable to the higher volume of business registered at Resorts World Genting (RWG), although the Group reported higher operating expenses during the period. In the UK and Egypt, the Group’s leisure and hospitality business recorded a 14% increase in revenue to RM1,895.6 million, largely attributable to overall higher volume of business. Notwithstanding higher operating and payroll related expenses, the Group registered a 2% increase in adjusted EBITDA to RM297.9 million. In the US and the Bahamas, the Group’s leisure and hospitality operations reported a 6% increase in revenue to RM1,980.1 million, primarily attributable to higher contributions from RWNYC. However, adjusted EBITDA declined by 4% to RM530.2 million, mainly due to higher operating and payroll related expenses. In line with the Group’s commitment to providing sustainable returns to shareholders, the Board of Directors (Board) has declared a final single-tier dividend of 4.0 sen per ordinary share. Together with the interim dividend of 6.0 sen per ordinary share, the Board has declared total dividend of 10.0 sen per ordinary share for FY24

body: Konglomerat ya hehe Genting Malaysia is one of the leading leisure and hospitality corporations in the world. Listed on Bursa Malaysia with approximately RM13 billion in market capitalisation, Genting Malaysia owns and operates major resort properties including Resorts World Genting (RWG) in Malaysia, Resorts World New York City (RWNYC), as well as Resorts World Catskills (RW Catskills) and Resorts World Hudson Valley (RW Hudson Valley) (which are 49%-owned via an associate company), in the United States (US), Resorts World Bimini (RW Bimini) in the Bahamas, Resorts World Birmingham (RW Birmingham) and over 30 casinos in the United Kingdom (UK), and Crockfords Cairo in Egypt. Genting Malaysia also owns and operates two seaside resorts in Malaysia, namely Resorts World Kijal in Terengganu and Resorts World Langkawi on Langkawi island. With about 10,500 rooms across seven distinct hotels, RWG is Malaysia’s premier integrated resort destination. The resort also features wide-ranging leisure and entertainment facilities, including gaming, theme park and amusement attractions, dining and retail outlets, as well as international shows and business convention facilities. Nestled amidst the mid-hills, Resorts World Awana complements this extensive premium experience with its natural greenery, mountainous golf course, trekking trails, and proximity to key attractions. Moreover, Genting Highlands Premium Outlets (a joint venture between Genting Plantations Berhad and Simon Property Group), further enriches RWG’s diverse offerings, solidifying its status as a leading leisure and entertainment hub in the region. In the UK, Genting Malaysia owns and operates over 30 casinos, making it one of the largest leisure and entertainment businesses in the country. The Group also operates RW Birmingham, the first integrated leisure complex of its kind in the UK, offering gaming and entertainment facilities, retail and dining outlets and a 182-room four-star hotel. In the Middle East, Crockfords Cairo, an exclusive casino nestled within the posh surroundings of The Nile Ritz-Carlton Hotel in Cairo, is the Group’s first venture into the region. In the US, Genting Malaysia operates RWNYC, the first and only video gaming machine facility (VGM) in New York City. As a premier entertainment hub, RWNYC houses over 6,500 slots and electronic table games, numerous casual and fine dining restaurants and bars, multi-purpose entertainment and event spaces, and the 400-room Hyatt Regency JFK Airport at RWNYC hotel. Additionally, Genting Malaysia operates RW Catskills and RW Hudson Valley in New York State. RW Catskills, which offers an enticing all-season entertainment experience, features live table games, sports betting, VGMs, over 400 rooms across two hotels, varied bar and restaurant experiences, as well as multi-purpose venues and conference spaces. RW Hudson Valley, a 60,000 sqft gaming and entertainment space, is the Group’s latest addition to its portfolio of casinos, featuring 1,200 slots and VGMs. Over in Miami, the Group owns the 527-room Hilton Miami Downtown which sits on 30 acres of prime freehold waterfront land. In the Bahamas, Genting Malaysia operates RW Bimini, which features a casino, Hilton at RW Bimini, restaurants and bars, various resort amenities, the RW Bimini Cruise Port, as well as the largest yacht and marina complex on the island surrounded by turquoise waters and white-sand beaches. Genting Malaysia is a member of the Genting Group, one of Asia’s leading and best-managed multinational companies. The Genting Group is led by Tan Sri Lim Kok Thay, a visionary entrepreneur who has successfully established the Resorts World brand as a leader in the leisure and hospitality sector in Malaysia, Singapore, the US, the Bahamas and the UK. Tan Sri Lim Kok Thay also has significant investments in other industries globally including oil palm plantations, property development, power generation, oil and gas, cruise and biotechnology

author: Good123
body: First target RM2 dulu ya Genting Malaysia - Hard Decisions to be Made Date: 2025-03-06 Firm: MAYBANK Stock: GENM Price Target: 2.41 Price Call: HOLD Last Price: 1.75 Upside/Downside: +0.66 (37.71%) Downgrade to HOLD and SOTP-TP to MYR2.41 (-12%) Results underperformed on weak margins. Thus, we cut FY25E/FY26E earnings estimates by 25%/26%. Rolling forward our valuation base year to end-FY25E, we cut our SOTP-based TP to MYR2.41 from MYR2.73. With <10% upside, we cut GENM to HOLD from BUY. We understand that dividends were cut to prepare to expand but fear that investors will not take it kindly. That said, we are sanguine that there will be no more equity injections into Empire and more mass gaming areas at RWG will reopen. Earnings and dividends below our expectations 4Q24 core net loss of MYR61.7m brought FY24A core net profit to MYR518.9m which accounted for only 76% of our FY estimate. The earnings shortfall was due to GENUK and RWNYC where higher staff cost caused their 4Q24 EBITDA to fall 47% QoQ and 39% QoQ. Furthermore, the final DPS of 4sen brought FY24A DPS to 10sen which accounted for only 67% of our FY estimate. GENM explained that it is conserving cash to potentially expand RWNYC for USD5.0b and bid for a Thai casino license for ≥USD3.0b. The not so good points … RWG EBITDA margin also hit a post-COVID low of 28% in 4Q24 on higher operating expenses. For FY25E, GENM is guiding lower RWG EBITDA margins of 30-31% going forward (30-33% previously). It is also guiding lower GENUK and US EBITDA margins of c.16% and c.27% respectively. Reflecting the above, we cut our FY25E/FY26E earnings estimates by 25%/26% and dividend estimates by 33%/33% (Fig. 2). While rolling forward our valuation base year to end-FY25E from end-FY24A, we also cut our SOTP-based TP by 12% to MYR2.41 (Fig. 3). We introduce FY27E estimates. … and the better points Much to our positive surprise, GENM does not expect to inject more equity into loss making associate, Empire Resorts (Not Listed). Going forward, RWG has plans to reopen more mass gaming floor area. Thus, there could be upside to our earnings estimates. Again, GENM is seeking approval to expand RWNYC to include tables games by year end and is interested in bidding for a Thai casino license. To be sure, GENM may bid for a Thai casino license separately from sister company, GENS. [Prior:BUY] Source: Maybank Research - 6 Mar 2025

body: The New York State Gaming Commission will soon award three new downstate New York Class III casino licences to eligible operators. Authorised in 2022, bidding for the licences will begin in June 2025 and are likely to be awarded between October 2025 and March 2026. With a Class III licence, RWNY can host all table games with physical dealers, which it cannot operate with its Class II licence currently. “We have factored in a casino licence win by RWNY into our projections for the financial years of 2025 to 2026 (FY25 to FY26), mainly reflected in the spike in FY26 capital expenditure that we expect to be majorly debt-funded. “In turn, we anticipate Genting New York and Genting Malaysia Bhd (GenM)/Genting Bhd to post a deterioration in credit metrics in FY26 and FY27, before improving thereafter as the new downstate casino opens,” said CreditSights. CreditSights initiated coverage on Genting with a “market perform” recommendation.

body: Genting Malaysia - Hard Decisions to be Made Date: 2025-03-06 Firm: MAYBANK Stock: GENM Price Target: 2.41 Price Call: HOLD Last Price: 1.70 Upside/Downside: +0.71 (41.76%) Downgrade to HOLD and SOTP-TP to MYR2.41 (-12%) Results underperformed on weak margins. Thus, we cut FY25E/FY26E earnings estimates by 25%/26%. Rolling forward our valuation base year to end-FY25E, we cut our SOTP-based TP to MYR2.41 from MYR2.73. With <10% upside, we cut GENM to HOLD from BUY. We understand that dividends were cut to prepare to expand but fear that investors will not take it kindly. That said, we are sanguine that there will be no more equity injections into Empire and more mass gaming areas at RWG will reopen. Earnings and dividends below our expectations 4Q24 core net loss of MYR61.7m brought FY24A core net profit to MYR518.9m which accounted for only 76% of our FY estimate. The earnings shortfall was due to GENUK and RWNYC where higher staff cost caused their 4Q24 EBITDA to fall 47% QoQ and 39% QoQ. Furthermore, the final DPS of 4sen brought FY24A DPS to 10sen which accounted for only 67% of our FY estimate. GENM explained that it is conserving cash to potentially expand RWNYC for USD5.0b and bid for a Thai casino license for ≥USD3.0b. The not so good points … RWG EBITDA margin also hit a post-COVID low of 28% in 4Q24 on higher operating expenses. For FY25E, GENM is guiding lower RWG EBITDA margins of 30-31% going forward (30-33% previously). It is also guiding lower GENUK and US EBITDA margins of c.16% and c.27% respectively. Reflecting the above, we cut our FY25E/FY26E earnings estimates by 25%/26% and dividend estimates by 33%/33% (Fig. 2). While rolling forward our valuation base year to end-FY25E from end-FY24A, we also cut our SOTP-based TP by 12% to MYR2.41 (Fig. 3). We introduce FY27E estimates. Much to our positive surprise, GENM does not expect to inject more equity into loss making associate, Empire Resorts (Not Listed). Going forward, RWG has plans to reopen more mass gaming floor area. Thus, there could be upside to our earnings estimates. Again, GENM is seeking approval to expand RWNYC to include tables games by year end and is interested in bidding for a Thai casino license. To be sure, GENM may bid for a Thai casino license separately from sister company, GENS. [Prior:BUY] Source: Maybank Research - 6 Mar 2025

body: January 6, 2025 Genting Malaysia (GENM MK) +ve on new Genting Casino but not enough to move the needle Impact of new mass gaming floor minor, in our view We are positive that GENM has opened another mass gaming floor. Yet, it is nowhere near the size of the Circus Palace and Hollywood mass gaming floors which remain closed for renovations. Thus, we refrain from raising our earnings estimates and DCF-TP. Nonetheless, we continue to believe that GENM’s valuations are attractive. Key risks are more related party transactions involving Empire Resorts and negative outcome from its USD600m lawsuit by RAV Bahamas (Not Listed). Circus Palace and Hollywood remain closed… We visited Resorts World Genting (RWG) on 30 Dec 2024 after hearing talks that the Circus Palace and Hollywood mass gaming floors have reopened. Recall that they were closed for renovation in Feb 2024. Alas, both mass gaming floors remain closed although it does appear to us that renovations are underway. GENM informed us that they will reopen eventually but a date has not been set yet. Instead, there were signs pointing us to another mass gaming floor called Genting Casino. … but another mass gaming floor opens The other Genting Casino is divided over 2 areas with 2 themes. 1 is similar to Sky Casino while the other is traditional Chinese. It has a lot of lower yielding slot machines and electronic tables but we understand that margins are higher as fewer staff are required. Only 36 conventional tables were deployed. Minimum table bets ranged from MYR10 to MYR100. There were no smoking lounges which is negative for length of play as gamblers have to leave the casino to smoke. BAU at Sky Casino with new smoking lounges Over at Sky Casino, we notice that the crowd was thin as the year end school holidays had just ended. Minimum table bets ranged from MYR25 to MYR100. It appears to us that most conventional tables that were placed on the first floor before have been replaced with lower yielding but higher margin slot machines and electronic tables to manage staff costs post- peak season. Positively, there were smoking lounges as this will not force gamblers to leave the casino to smoke. body: The Group is cautiously optimistic of the near-term prospects of the leisure and hospitality industry and remains positive in the longer-term. In Malaysia, the Group remains focused on strengthening its yielding capabilities, enhancing operational efficiencies and leveraging database marketing to optimise performance. Efforts will also be directed toward refining marketing strategies to increase visitation at RWG, whilst maintaining a diverse range of offerings that deliver maximum value to guests. Additionally, the Group will continue to place emphasis on effective cost management to maintain resilience and ensure business agility in an evolving operating environment. Ongoing investments in infrastructure upgrades and new attractions at Genting Highlands, including new ecotourism experiences set to launch this year, will further elevate the Group’s offerings. In addition, to celebrate the Genting Group’s 60th anniversary, a series of promotional events and activities will be introduced throughout the year to attract more visitors to RWG. In the UK, the Group will remain agile in responding to evolving market conditions whilst identifying new growth opportunities to expand its market share. At the same time, the Group will continue to focus on improving operational efficiencies and driving productivity gains. A disciplined approach to cost management will be maintained, alongside ongoing efforts to optimise performance and deliver sustained growth across its operations. The Group will also invest in enhancing its product offerings, introducing innovative solutions to meet customer needs and strengthen its competitive position. In the US, the Group remains focused on strategically expanding its footprint, enhancing operational capabilities and strengthening its market presence. By leveraging synergies between RWNYC and Empire, the Group aims to drive sustained growth and improve the overall returns from its US business. Additionally, the Group is closely monitoring developments related to the New York Gaming Facility Board's Request for Applications, which could result in the licensing of up to three new commercial casinos in the state. In the Bahamas, the Group will deepen its collaboration with international cruise operators to drive more port calls at RW Bimini. At the same time, the Group will ramp up marketing initiatives to attract more visitors and focus on optimizing operations and controlling costs to enhance profitability

author: Good123
body: According to the latest Travel and Tour World report, a key driver of this growth is the proactive approach of the Ministry of Tourism, Arts, and Culture (Motac), which has significantly expanded Malaysia’s international air connectivity. Since mid-2024, Motac has facilitated over 3,100 weekly international flights, offering a combined capacity of 620,000 seats. This increased accessibility has been crucial in setting the stage for heightened tourism flows, with Malaysia becoming even more accessible to travellers from around the world. Record-breaking growth from key markets The impressive performance of 2024 has already set a strong foundation for 2025. Malaysia has exceeded its tourist arrival targets from India and witnessed a major rebound in travel from China. According to Datuk Dr Angie Ng, President of the Malaysian Inbound Chinese Association, nearly 3 million Chinese visitors arrived in Malaysia in 2024, marking a staggering 136.5% increase. This surge reflects the renewed confidence of Chinese travellers in Malaysia as a top-tier destination. Singapore remains Malaysia’s largest source of tourists, contributing 7.6 million visitors between January and October 2024. Indonesia follows closely with over 3.1 million arrivals, while Thailand (1.4 million) and Brunei (nearly 1 million, a 51% growth) are also showing encouraging trends. Notably, India emerged as a standout performer, with a 72% year-on-year increase, bringing in over 961,000 visitors. South Korea and Taiwan also contributed significantly, with 412,000 and 349,000 visitors, respectively.

body: Gambling in the United States - statistics & facts Choose a region: Whether it be Las Vegas or Atlantic City, the United States is home to some of the most renowned gambling locations in the world. Accordingly, while the laws and regulations surrounding gambling vary from state to state, gambling is undeniably woven into the cultural iconography of the United States. The gambling industry is also a major cog in the U.S. economy, with the national commercial gross gaming revenue (GGR) reaching 66.65 billion U.S. dollars in 2023. The majority of this revenue is generated by casino slots and tables games, which totaled around three-quarters of total GGR in 2023. That year, Nevada’s GGR outstripped every other U.S. state, totaling over 15 billion U.S. dollars. In comparison, Pennsylvania generated the second-highest amount of GGR, with 5.86 billion U.S. dollars. Where is gambling legal in the U.S.? Under federal law, gambling is legal in the U.S., however, each state can define its own regulations as it sees fit. Consequently, it is easy to lose track of what distinctions make certain forms of gambling illegal in one state, but perfectly acceptable in another. For example, following federal legislature in 2018 legalizing sports betting, 38 states decided to follow suit as of September 2024. However, eight of these states decided to only allow in-person sports betting. As is also often the case, there have been conflicts in interpreting legislation at state and federal level. One instance of this is daily fantasy sports (DFS) in the state of Nevada, with the state’s Gaming Control Board insisting that DFS are a form of gambling and therefore require a license. However, leading DFS platforms have argued that under the 2006 Unlawful Gambling Enforcement Act, fantasy sports are recognized as a game of skill rather than luck, and therefore do not need to pay for a gaming license. As of 2024, this conflict had yet to have been resolved, creating the bizarre situation of popular apps such as DraftKings or FanDuel not being accessible in the U.S. capital of gambling, Las Vegas. How many people gamble in the U.S.? Recent years have seen an uptake in gambling in the U.S., with 49 percent of U.S. adults saying they participated in gambling in 2023. In comparison, 43 percent took part in 2019. Concurrently, attitudes towards gambling have become increasingly permissive in the U.S., with 56 percent of adults saying they found it acceptable in 2023. Four years previously, this figure had stood at 50 percent. When it comes to the most popular forms of gambling in the U.S., playing the lottery has been the consistent favorite, with 37 percent of the U.S. population having taken part in 2023. Looking to the future, there is an expectation that the U.S. gambling industry will grow steadily over the coming years. This is especially true for online gambling, whose market size was forecast to grow from around 14 billion U.S. dollars in 2023 to close to 40 billion U.S. dollars by 2029. However, in person gambling is not expected to disappear any time soon, especially in locations such as Las Vegas, where visiting casinos is part of the holistic touristic experience. body: Sports betting worldwide - statistics & facts Choose a region: Sports betting is a type of gambling that refers to the activity of placing a wager on the outcome of a sporting event. Events on which wagers are made could be anything from more traditional activities like horse or dog racing to sports such as soccer and American football. Bets are typically made through bookmakers, also known as sportsbooks. These operate both as land-based establishments, for example, at casinos or betting shops, and online. The total amount of money wagered by bettors is known as a handle, while the amount of money earned by a sportsbook after paying out the winners is revenue. In 2022, the sports betting and lottery market size worldwide amounted to 235.46 billion U.S. dollars. Where is the biggest sports betting market in the world? While the global market is large and lucrative, sports betting is still not legal everywhere. Furthermore, the countries that do offer legal sports betting also offer many other types of gambling. For these reasons, it is often difficult to definitively identify the market leader when it comes to sports betting alone. Of the leading gambling companies worldwide, the top company, bet365, was based in the United Kingdom, while Genting and Wynn Resorts, were based in Malaysia and the United States, respectively. All three companies reported a brand value of over three billion U.S. dollars in 2022, with bet365 exceeding the four billion dollar mark that year. Although gambling markets are often based around casino and lottery games, the sports betting sector has been growing in popularity across the world. In 2022, the gross revenue from the Macao soccer sports lottery alone totaled 386 million Macao patacas. The same year, the total sports betting revenue in the U.S. reached 7.56 billion U.S. dollars. What is the preferred method of betting on sports? One of the major gambling trends in recent years has been the rise of online betting. In the United States alone, sports bettors are nearly three times more likely to place their bets online rather than in person. Accordingly, the number of online sports bettors in the United States was forecast to rise from around 25 million in 2022 to nearly 37 million by 2025, representing an increase of 47 percent. However, this turn to online betting has by no means been confined to the United States or sports betting, with the market size of the global online gambling industry reaching 63.53 billion U.S. dollars in 2022 and being expected to rise to over 184 billion U.S. dollars by 2032. body: Booster for genm ya😎🤩 SHANGHAI (Reuters) - Wall Street firm Morgan Stanley raised on Wednesday its index targets for Chinese shares for the second time this year, citing improved earnings growth forecasts and a more optimistic outlook for the economy and currency. The bank upgraded its year-end index targets for Hong Kong’s benchmark Hang Seng Index, Hang Seng China Enterprises index, MSCI China index, and China’s blue-chip CSI300 index to 25,800, 9,500, 83, and 4,220 points, respectively. "The new and higher index price targets are driven by both moderate increases in earnings growth forecasts and higher valuation targets," the U.S. bank said in a note. It also cited "improved macro and FX outlook forecasts". Morgan Stanley noted that earnings results for the fourth quarter of last year from companies tracked by the MSCI China index "are showing a solid 8% net beat", both in terms of the number of companies and weighted earnings – marking the first time in 3-1/2 years. Chinese stocks have gained momentum this year, with the MSCI China Index rising about 16% so far, outperforming global peers. This rise is fuelled by investor optimism surrounding progress in generative AI and Beijing’s stimulus measures aimed at boosting consumption and supporting the broader economy. [.SS] Developments in trade relations between the United States and China have been a key focus for investors. The White House said last week that U.S. President Donald Trump still intends to impose new reciprocal tariffs on several U.S. trading partners, starting April 2. Morgan Stanley also raised its forecast for China’s economic growth in 2025 to 4.5%, up from the previous estimate of 4%. The brokerage revised its yuan predictions to 7.35 per dollar by mid-2025 and 7.50 by the end of this year, compared with its prior forecast of 7.50 and 7.60, respectively. "We have always made the point that currency strength serves as an important factor for Chinese equities, especially for the offshore market. "This is because foreign investors’ funding costs are usually in U.S. dollar terms, which means a relatively stronger or less weak currency should be a positive catalyst from an asset allocation perspective." © Reuters. body: Genting Malaysia, a subsidiary of the Malaysian gaming giant Genting Bhd, has expressed interest in bidding for a casino license in Thailand, potentially setting the stage for a competitive showdown with its sister company, Genting Singapore. As of early 2025, reports indicate that Genting Malaysia’s management is considering a separate bid from Genting Singapore for a Thai integrated resort (IR) and casino license, should Thailand finalize its plans to legalize casino gaming. This interest was confirmed by analysts at Maybank Investment Bank following Genting Malaysia’s 4Q24 earnings call, where the company signaled its intent to explore this opportunity. Thailand’s push to legalize casinos has gained momentum, with the Thai Cabinet approving a draft Entertainment Complex Business Act in principle by January 2025. This legislation aims to regulate and tax the country’s gambling market while creating comprehensive tourist destinations that include casinos as a small component (about 5% of the complex area). The initiative has attracted attention from multiple global operators, including Genting Malaysia, alongside names like Galaxy Entertainment Group, Las Vegas Sands, MGM Resorts, Wynn Resorts, and Melco Resorts. These complexes are envisioned as large-scale developments on state-owned land near major tourism hubs, requiring significant investment—estimated at a minimum of 100 billion baht (around $2.89 billion USD)—and are expected to boost Thailand’s tourism revenue and GDP. Genting Malaysia’s potential bid comes as it already operates Resorts World Genting in Malaysia, three casinos in New York, and properties in the UK, giving it a strong operational foundation. However, analysts note that Genting Singapore, which runs Resorts World Sentosa and has a healthier cash position, might have an edge in the bidding process. The two companies, while related under the Genting Bhd umbrella (with Genting Bhd owning 49.5% of Genting Malaysia and 52.7% of Genting Singapore), operate independently, and their management views them as separate entities capable of pursuing distinct strategies. The Thai casino opportunity is seen as both a threat and an opportunity for Genting Malaysia. A new Thai IR could compete with Resorts World Genting for regional tourists, particularly from Malaysia and Singapore. However, analysts from Nomura and Maybank suggest that Genting Malaysia is likely to bid to secure a foothold in Thailand, leveraging its experience in the gaming and hospitality sectors. This move aligns with the company’s history of exploring international expansion, as seen in its past bids in Macau and New York. As of March 26, 2025, Thailand’s casino legalization process is still unfolding, with a feasibility study completed and a draft bill under review. While specifics like local entry restrictions (e.g., a proposed 50 million baht bank account requirement) remain contentious, Genting Malaysia’s interest positions it as a key player in this emerging market. The outcome of its bid—and whether it will indeed compete head-to-head with Genting Singapore—will depend on Thailand’s final regulatory framework and the competitive landscape that emerges.

author: Good123
body: 😍 Singaporean gamblers are drawn to Genting Malaysia for several reasons, despite having Marina Bay Sands (MBS) and Resorts World Sentosa (RWS) in their own country. Here’s why: 1. Lower Costs & Fewer Restrictions • Entry Fee in Singapore: Singaporeans and PRs must pay SGD 150 (~RM 525) per entry or SGD 3,000 (~RM 10,500) annually to enter casinos in MBS and RWS. In contrast, Genting Malaysia has no entry fee. • Lower Minimum Bets: Genting generally has lower minimum bets compared to high-end Singaporean casinos, making it accessible to casual gamblers. 2. Variety & Atmosphere • Larger Gaming Options: Genting has over 400 table games and 3,000 slot machines, offering a broader selection than Singapore’s casinos. • Relaxed Environment: MBS and RWS cater more to high-rollers, while Genting feels more casual, attracting both serious and recreational players. • Cool Weather: The highland climate provides a refreshing escape from Singapore’s humidity. 3. Entertainment & Family Activities • Many Singaporeans visit Genting not just for gambling but also for its theme parks, shopping malls, concerts, and nightlife, making it a well-rounded holiday destination. • Families can enjoy SkyWorlds Theme Park, Skytropolis indoor park, and premium outlet shopping, unlike Singapore’s integrated resorts which focus heavily on luxury. 4. VIP & Junket Programs • Genting Malaysia has strong ties with junket operators and exclusive VIP rooms that cater to Singaporean high-rollers, sometimes offering better incentives than Singapore’s own casinos. 5. Nostalgia & Tradition • Genting has been a gambling hotspot for Singaporeans since the 1980s, long before Singapore legalized casinos in 2010. Many still prefer it out of habit and loyalty. 6. Currency Exchange Advantage • The weaker Malaysian Ringgit makes Genting more affordable than Singaporean casinos, especially for smaller-stake gamblers. 7. Privacy & Discretion • Some Singaporeans prefer gambling outside their home country to avoid social stigma or government scrutiny. Conclusion Genting Malaysia remains a popular choice for Singaporean gamblers because it offers a more affordable, relaxed, and entertainment-packed experience compared to the more regulated and expensive casinos in Singapore.

author: Good123
body: 😎 Yes! Genting Malaysia is not just about gambling—it’s a full-fledged entertainment and holiday destination with many non-gambling activities that attract families, couples, and tourists. Here’s what makes it appealing beyond the casino: ⸻ 1. Theme Parks & Family Attractions • Genting SkyWorlds Theme Park – A world-class outdoor theme park with rides based on Hollywood movies like Ice Age, Rio, and Night at the Museum. • Skytropolis Indoor Theme Park – A massive indoor amusement park with thrill rides, arcade games, and VR experiences. • Ripley’s Believe It or Not! Adventureland – Featuring oddities, haunted adventures, and interactive exhibits. • Genting Highlands Premium Outlets – A must-visit for shopping enthusiasts with branded factory outlets at discounted prices. ⸻ 2. Shopping & Dining • SkyAvenue Mall – A massive shopping mall with luxury brands, electronics, and souvenirs. • Gohtong Jaya & Genting Grand Dining – Offers everything from Michelin-starred restaurants to street food. • Malaysian Food Street – A food court featuring authentic Malaysian dishes like Nasi Lemak, Char Kway Teow, and Satay. ⸻ 3. Live Shows & Entertainment • Arena of Stars – Hosts concerts by international and Asian artists, comedy shows, and magic performances. • Zouk Genting – A high-end nightclub with DJs, live music, and a great nightlife scene. • SkySymphony Light & Sound Show – A free 3D multimedia show with floating LED balls and digital projections at SkyAvenue. ⸻ 4. Outdoor Activities & Relaxation • Awana SkyWay & Cable Car – Offers a breathtaking ride with panoramic views of the rainforest and mountains. • Chin Swee Caves Temple – A serene Buddhist temple with a stunning pagoda, giant Buddha statue, and scenic views. • Golfing & Hiking – The Awana Golf Course and nearby hiking trails like Gunung Bunga Buah offer outdoor adventures. • Luxury Spas & Wellness Centers – Relax with massages, facials, and hot stone therapy at high-end spa resorts. ⸻ 5. Unique Experiences • Snow World – A winter wonderland with artificial snow, ice slides, and igloos. • Sky VR – Virtual reality gaming, including roller coasters and zombie survival experiences. • BigTop Video Games Park – A paradise for arcade lovers with classic games, simulators, and claw machines. ⸻ Conclusion Genting Highlands is a multi-purpose destination, offering something for gamblers, families, couples, adventure seekers, and luxury travelers. Whether you’re there for thrilling rides, shopping, nature, or entertainment, it’s much more than just a casino!

body: KUALA LUMPUR: Malaysia's economy is expected to remain resilient despite the escalating tariff tensions with the United States, according to the Malaysian Rating Corporation (MARC Rating). The corporation's sensitivity analysis suggests that while the tariff impact may result in moderate adjustments, Malaysia's overall economic performance will not face a significant downturn. Of note, it said Malaysia's net exports to to the US edged up to 4.4 per cent of gross domestic product (GDP) in 2024, showing only mild fluctuations since the pandemic. "Given the tariff shock coupled with a decline in regional and global growth, we estimate that Malaysia's 2025 GDP could decrease by up to 1 per cent per annum from our prior baseline growth forecast of 5 per cent; furthermore, the adverse effects of the trade war are likely to persist into 2026," it said. As such, MARC Rating said the uncertainty factor is significant, as forecasts will be adversely affected if tariff retaliation is pursued and prolonged and if separate negotiations between the US and other countries occur in a fragmented manner, leading to complex spillover effects. Nonetheless, the rating agency said Malaysia's overall GDP is buffered by its strong, domestically driven economic base, at almost two-thirds of GDP. "The semiconductor sector, which is partially exempted from the tariffs, also plays a key role, accounting for more than a quarter of Malaysia's exports to the US. "These mitigating factors suggest that the country's economic base remains well-positioned to weather the storm," it said. Meanwhile, MARC Rating said Malaysia's position in global trade negotiations is bolstered by its leadership role as chair of the Asean bloc and participation in key regional trade agreements. This includes the Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP) and the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP). "Additionally, Trump's invocation of the International Emergency Economic Powers Act can be challenged under the World Trade Organisation's (WTO) Most Favoured Nation (MFN) obligation mandating non-discriminatory tariff levels between countries, among other regulations such as a due process for dispute resolution and the substantiation of these broad tariffs as an actual national security concern," it added.

Resilient Business Model: The company benefits from steady domestic visitation, especially from day-trippers and local punters, ensuring consistent revenue even during downturns. 4. Regional Expansion: Genting Malaysia is actively expanding into new markets, including potential bids for casino licenses in Thailand and New York, which demonstrates its ability to adapt and compete globally. These factors make Genting Malaysia well-equipped to maintain its competitive edge in ASEAN’s gaming industry.

author: Good123
body: The current economic situation in Malaysia is driving more Malaysians to have domestic holidays, which is benefiting Genting Malaysia for several reasons: 1. Economic Recovery and Domestic Tourism Boom: Malaysia’s tourism sector is experiencing a significant rebound, with projections indicating growth beyond pre-pandemic levels. The Economic Outlook 2025 report suggests that the travel and tourism industry is fully recovering globally, which includes a surge in domestic tourism. This trend is likely to benefit Genting Malaysia as more Malaysians choose local destinations for their holidays. 2. Increased Disposable Income: The World Travel & Tourism Council (WTTC) projects that Malaysia’s Travel & Tourism sector will contribute MYR 198.7BN to the national economy in 2024, representing 10.5% of the total economy. This economic growth may lead to increased disposable income for Malaysians, making domestic travel more affordable and attractive. 3. Rising Domestic Visitor Spending: Domestic visitor spending is expected to reach MYR 106.5BN in 2024, which is more than one-fifth (21.6%) above 2019 levels. This surge in domestic spending directly benefits attractions like Genting Malaysia, as locals are more likely to visit and spend money at these destinations. 4. Employment Growth in Tourism: The tourism sector is projected to employ more than 2.4 million people in 2024, growing 5.2% compared to the previous year. This increase in employment may lead to more Malaysians having the means to travel domestically, potentially boosting visitor numbers to Genting Malaysia. 5. Government Initiatives: The Malaysian government is focusing on upgrading facilities and systems at all entry ports, as well as promoting various state-level visit year programs. These initiatives are likely to enhance the overall tourism infrastructure, making it easier and more appealing for Malaysians to travel within the country, including to destinations like Genting Highlands. 6. Competitive Advantage of Genting Malaysia: As a well-established brand offering a diverse range of attractions including theme parks, casinos, and entertainment venues, Genting Malaysia is well-positioned to capture a significant portion of the growing domestic tourism market. Its ability to cater to various demographics and offer unique experiences gives it a competitive edge in attracting Malaysian tourists. 7. Currency Fluctuations: While not explicitly mentioned in the search results, economic situations often involve currency fluctuations. If the Malaysian Ringgit weakens against foreign currencies, it may make international travel more expensive for Malaysians, further encouraging them to choose domestic destinations like Genting Malaysia for their holidays. 8. Promotional Activities: The government’s focus on intensifying promotions for Visit Malaysia Year 2026 and increasing Malaysia’s visibility at international events is likely to create a ripple effect, raising awareness among Malaysians about their country’s tourist attractions, including Genting Malaysia. In conclusion, the combination of economic recovery, increased domestic tourism spending, government initiatives, and Genting Malaysia’s strong market position is creating a favorable environment for the company to benefit from the trend of Malaysians choosing domestic holidays. This situation is likely to enrich Genting Malaysia by increasing its visitor numbers, revenue, and overall market share in the Malaysian tourism industry.

author: Good123
body: More Indians are expected to visit Malaysia, including Genting Malaysia, due to several factors: 1. Free Visa Entry: The introduction of free visa entry for Indians in December 2023 has significantly boosted tourist arrivals from India, making travel to Malaysia more accessible and appealing. 2. Increased Air Connectivity: New direct flights from India to various Malaysian destinations, such as Penang and Langkawi, enhance travel convenience and encourage more visitors. 3. Promotional Campaigns: Tourism Malaysia’s strategic marketing efforts, including the Visit Malaysia 2026 campaign, are actively targeting Indian travelers through events like SATTE 2025. 4. Niche Tourism Focus: Malaysia is promoting niche segments like golf tourism, weddings, and MICE events to attract a broader range of Indian tourists. These initiatives are likely to increase Indian visitor numbers to destinations like Genting Malaysia, benefiting from the overall growth in tourism.

author: Good123
body: Indonesians are increasingly visiting Malaysia, including Genting Malaysia, for several reasons: 1. Proximity and Accessibility: Malaysia is geographically close to Indonesia, making it an easily accessible destination. Improved air connectivity and frequent flights enhance this accessibility. 2. Cultural and Economic Ties: The two countries share cultural and economic ties, which foster travel between them. Indonesia is one of the largest sources of tourists for Malaysia, with over 3.1 million arrivals in 2024. 3. Affordability and Variety: Malaysia offers a diverse range of attractions, from urban experiences to natural beauty, at relatively affordable prices compared to other international destinations. This variety appeals to Indonesian travelers seeking different experiences. 4. Promotional Efforts: Tourism Malaysia actively promotes its destinations to Indonesian travelers through targeted marketing campaigns and participation in travel fairs.

author: Good123
body: Middle Eastern tourists are increasingly visiting Malaysia, including Genting Malaysia, due to several factors: 1. Muslim-Friendly Environment: Malaysia is a top destination for Muslim travelers, offering halal food, prayer facilities, and cultural familiarity. This aligns well with the preferences of Middle Eastern tourists. 2. Cool Climate and Escaping Heat: Many Middle Eastern visitors seek Malaysia’s cooler climate and lush landscapes during their summer months to escape the extreme heat in their home countries. 3. Visa-Free Access: Nationals from Gulf states enjoy visa-free entry to Malaysia, allowing them to stay for up to three months, which simplifies travel planning. 4. High Spending Power: Middle Eastern tourists, especially Saudis, are high-end travelers who spend significantly on shopping, healthcare, and luxury accommodations. Genting Malaysia benefits from this spending through its premium offerings. 5. Health Tourism Appeal: Malaysia’s high-quality yet affordable private healthcare services attract Middle Eastern visitors seeking medical tourism packages. These factors make Malaysia, including Genting Highlands, a favored destination for Middle Eastern tourists.

author: Good123
body: The Malaysia My Second Home (MM2H) program has boosted Genting Malaysia in several ways: 1. Increased Foreign Investment: The MM2H program attracts high-net-worth individuals who invest in real estate and other sectors, contributing to economic growth. This influx of affluent visitors can increase spending at Genting Highlands, benefiting its resorts and entertainment facilities. 2. Long-Term Residency: MM2H participants often spend extended periods in Malaysia, which can lead to more frequent visits to popular destinations like Genting Highlands. This consistent flow of visitors supports Genting’s business by ensuring a steady stream of customers. 3. Economic Multiplier Effect: The investments and spending by MM2H participants create a multiplier effect, boosting local economies and encouraging more tourism-related activities. This can indirectly benefit Genting Malaysia by enhancing the overall appeal of Malaysia as a tourist destination.

author: Good123
body: The boom in Malaysia’s education sector, driven by the influx of foreign students, has indirectly benefited Genting Malaysia in several ways: 1. Increased Domestic Travel by Foreign Students: Foreign students studying in Malaysia often travel during their semester breaks, exploring popular destinations like Genting Highlands. Research shows that Genting is a favored spot among international students due to its cool climate, entertainment options, and accessibility. 2. Word-of-Mouth Promotion: Positive experiences shared by foreign students through electronic word-of-mouth (E-WOM) significantly influence other students’ travel intentions. This boosts visitation to attractions like Resorts World Genting. 3. Spending Power: Foreign students contribute to the economy through leisure spending on accommodations, entertainment, and dining during their travels. Genting Malaysia benefits from this spending at its hotels, theme parks, and casinos. 4. Tourism Synergy: The growing number of international students enhances Malaysia’s image as a global hub for education and tourism. This synergy aligns with the government’s efforts to promote destinations like Genting Highlands as part of its broader tourism strategy. These factors make the education sector’s growth an indirect driver of Genting Malaysia’s success.

author: Good123

Higher Domestic Tourism: Foreign students often travel within Malaysia during breaks, with Genting Highlands being a popular destination. This contributes to increased visitation at Resorts World Genting. 2. Spending Power: Foreign students and their families spend significantly on leisure activities, including entertainment, accommodations, and dining. Genting Malaysia benefits from this spending at its integrated resort offerings. 3. Boosted Attendance: The growing number of international visitors, including foreign students, aligns with Genting Malaysia’s strategy to drive attendance and capitalize on inbound tourism growth.

author: Good123
body: The increase in foreign students and returning foreign visitors impacts Genting Malaysia’s revenue differently: Foreign Students 1. Consistent Domestic Spending: Foreign students contribute to steady domestic tourism as they explore Malaysia during holidays, often visiting Genting Highlands. Their spending on entertainment, accommodations, and dining supports Genting Malaysia’s revenue. 2. Word-of-Mouth Promotion: Positive experiences shared by foreign students can attract more visitors from their home countries, indirectly benefiting Genting Malaysia. Returning Foreign Visitors 1. Higher Revenue Contribution: Returning foreign visitors, particularly from key markets like China and India, have a more significant impact on Genting Malaysia’s revenue. For example, foreign tourists account for 15–20% of Resorts World Genting’s arrivals but contribute disproportionately due to higher spending power. 2. Post-Pandemic Recovery Boost: The return of foreign tourists has driven a sharp increase in attendance, with overseas visitors growing by over 100% year-on-year in 2023. This helped Genting Malaysia reverse prior losses and achieve profitability. 3. Government Support: Tourism promotion campaigns and visa-free access for key markets like China and India have further fueled the return of international visitors, directly benefiting Genting Malaysia. Comparison While foreign students provide consistent but moderate revenue through domestic tourism, returning foreign visitors have a larger and more immediate impact on Genting Malaysia’s earnings due to their higher spending and the volume of arrivals driven by targeted government initiatives.

author: Joo1818
body: Genting Malaysia wrote off its US$426.3 million (including accrued interest) investment in promissory notes issued by the Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe in 2018. This impairment loss was due to the US Department of Interior's ruling that the Tribe did not satisfy the conditions to have the land in trust for their planned casino project. While the loan was written off, there have been ongoing developments that could potentially lead to a write-back of the investment. These include: * Changes in US government stance: The Biden administration, with its pro-Native American stance and the appointment of Deb Haaland as Secretary of the Interior, created a possibility for the Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe to have their reservation land held in trust again. * Legal developments: There have been legal challenges and legislative efforts (such as the Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe Reservation Reaffirmation Act) aimed at reaffirming the Tribe's land in trust, which would allow the casino project to proceed. * Tribe's continued efforts: The Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe has continued to work towards developing their casino, including announcing plans to present a phased development strategy in early 2025. In summary, the loan was written off in 2018, meaning it was considered unrecoverable at that time. However, the situation is not entirely closed. Analysts and Genting Malaysia itself have discussed the possibility of a "write-back" of the impaired notes if the legal and political hurdles are overcome and the casino project can proceed. This would represent a recovery of the investment, but it is not a certainty and depends on future developments.

author: Joo1818
body: Taunton Casino | Tribe Pays City $2.4 million May 9, 2025 The Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe paid $2.4 million to the City of Taunton on Wednesday. The payment amount covers past due payments owed to the city under the original casino agreement. It follows a March 2025 memorandum of agreement (MOA) between the tribe and the city that allows the tribe to collect gaming revenues at its First Light Welcome Center. The tribe agreed to pay 2.05% of the gaming revenues to the city, and the city agreed to postpone legal action on the past due amount of $2.4 million. That liability is now paid in full with the financial help of Genting, a casino partner of the Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe. First Light Welcome Center is a 2,000-square-foot modular building at 1 O'Connell Way in East Taunton. The center provides visitors with a preview of the future First Light Resort and Casino and Mashpee Wampanoag tribal art and cultural displays. Hours are 10 AM to 6 PM Tuesday through Saturday. The Welcome Center currently features 50 slot machines. The Chairman of the Mashpee Wampanoag Tribe, Brian Weeden, recently told the Gazette the facility will be expanded to provide "more opportunities for entertainment, additional artifacts and new material on our culture."

body: Here's a summary of the latest status of Genting Malaysia Bhd (GENM) and information regarding its resolutions: Latest Status of Genting Malaysia Bhd (GENM) generated by AI Gemini: * Financial Performance (Q1 2025): Genting Malaysia Bhd reported a 25.69% year-on-year increase in net profit to RM72.58 million for the first quarter ended March 31, 2025, primarily due to foreign exchange gains and improved cost management. However, quarterly revenue slipped by 6.14% to RM2.6 billion due to weaker contributions from its leisure and hospitality segments in Malaysia and the UK, as well as currency translation effects. (The Edge Malaysia, May 29, 2025) * Acquisition of Empire Resorts LLC: Genting Malaysia is in the process of acquiring the remaining 51% stake in Genting Empire Resorts LLC (GERL) for US$41 million (RM177 million) from the Lim family's Kien Huat Realty III Ltd. This will give GENM full control of Empire Resorts, which operates Resorts World Catskills, Resorts World Hudson Valley, and the mobile betting platform Resorts World Bet. The acquisition is expected to be completed by the end of Q2 2025, subject to regulatory approval from the New York State Gaming Commission. (The Edge Malaysia, May 2, 2025) * Analyst Concerns: Some analysts have flagged this acquisition as potentially expensive and profit-dilutive, expecting losses from GERL to widen and potentially impacting GENM's earnings. (New Straits Times, May 4, 2025) * Dividend: For Q1 2025, no dividend was announced. The last reported dividend (Final Single-Tier Dividend of 4.0 sen per ordinary share) had an ex-date of March 14, 2025, and a payment date of April 10, 2025. An interim dividend of 6.0 sen per share is expected with an ex-date of September 17, 2024, and payment on October 11, 2024. * Outlook: The group remains cautiously optimistic on its near-term prospects, acknowledging that the regional gaming market may face increasing challenges, although the hospitality sector is still positive. They aim to enhance Resorts World Genting's appeal through new ecotourism offerings and anniversary celebrations. They are also monitoring and preparing to participate in the New York Gaming Facility Board's Request for Applications. (The Edge Malaysia, May 29, 2025) * Stock Performance: Genting Malaysia's share price has seen some fluctuations. There have been analyst downgrades and a more cautious sentiment following weaker-than-expected FY2024 results, rising debt, and a reduced dividend per share for FY2024. (The Edge Malaysia, Nov 11, 2024) Resolutions Approved: Genting Malaysia Bhd held its Forty-Fifth Annual General Meeting (AGM) on June 11, 2025, at 10:00 AM at 26th Floor, Wisma Genting, Kuala Lumpur. Based on the Notice of Meeting, the following resolutions were tabled for shareholder approval: * Ordinary Resolution 1: To approve the proposed renewal of shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions of a revenue or trading nature and proposed new shareholders' mandate for additional recurrent related party transactions of a revenue or trading nature. * Ordinary Resolution 2: To approve the payment of Directors' fees totalling RM1,904,098 for the financial year ended 31 December 2024. * Ordinary Resolution 3: To approve the payment of Directors' benefits-in-kind from the date immediately after the Forty-Fifth Annual General Meeting to the date of the next AGM in 2026. * Ordinary Resolutions for Re-election of Directors: Resolutions related to the re-election of directors (the specific number of resolutions for re-election was not detailed in the snippet but typically involves several individuals). * Ordinary Resolution for Re-appointment of Auditors: To re-appoint PricewaterhouseCoopers PLT as Auditors and to authorise the Directors to fix their remuneration. * Ordinary Resolution for Authority to Directors: To approve the authority to Directors pursuant to Sections 75 and 76 of the Companies Act 2016. * Ordinary Resolution for Share Buy-back: To approve the proposed renewal of the authority for the Company to purchase its own shares. author: Joo1818
body: Consolidating the financials of Empire Resorts Inc. (which includes Resorts World Catskills and Resorts World Hudson Valley) with Genting's existing operations in New York, particularly Resorts World New York City (RWNY), is generally seen as a positive strategic move that could help Genting in its bid to obtain a full casino license from the New York Gaming Commission. Here's why: * Demonstrates a Unified and Stronger Presence: By fully acquiring Empire Resorts, Genting Malaysia presents a more unified and substantial presence in the New York gaming market. It shows a clear commitment to the state and its existing assets. This consolidated structure can demonstrate to the Gaming Commission that Genting has a comprehensive and integrated strategy for its operations in the region. * Operational Synergies and Cross-Marketing: Full ownership allows Genting to better leverage synergies between RWNY (a video lottery terminal facility in Queens, NYC, a high-traffic area) and Empire Resorts' properties (Resorts World Catskills, a full-scale casino in a more rural area, and Resorts World Hudson Valley). This includes: * Cross-marketing: Directing customers from RWNY to Catskills and vice-versa, creating a broader customer base across their New York properties. * Cost Efficiencies: Streamlining management, operations, and potentially supply chains across all New York assets. * Enhanced Brand Recognition: Further solidifying the "Resorts World" brand as a dominant player in the New York gaming landscape. * Streamlined Decision-Making: With 100% ownership, Genting can implement strategies more effectively and swiftly across all its New York operations without needing to navigate joint venture complexities or minority shareholder interests. This agility can be appealing to regulators looking for operators with clear plans and efficient execution capabilities. * Tax Benefits (Potentially): While Empire Resorts has been loss-making, consolidating its financials can potentially allow Genting to utilize those non-operating losses within its U.S. consolidated tax group, making them a more valuable tax asset. This could be seen as a sign of long-term financial planning and optimization. * Addressing Governance Concerns: The prior related-party transactions and the continued financial support to Empire Resorts had raised some corporate governance concerns. By taking full control, Genting Malaysia simplifies the ownership structure and potentially mitigates future questions about the flow of funds between related entities, presenting a cleaner operational picture to regulators. However, it's not without its challenges: * Financial Burden: As you noted, Empire Resorts has been a loss-making entity for a long time. Full consolidation means Genting Malaysia will fully absorb these losses, which analysts have already flagged as "profit-dilutive" in the short term. The Gaming Commission will want to see a financially stable operator, and while Genting Malaysia is a large and diversified group, the burden of a persistently loss-making subsidiary could be a point of scrutiny. * Competition: The competition for the downstate New York casino licenses is intense, with many well-capitalized and experienced operators vying for the limited number of licenses. Genting's consolidation helps its existing position, but it doesn't guarantee a win. New York Casino License Timeline: The New York Gaming Commission is expected to announce the full casino licenses in late 2025.

author: Joo1818
body: Both MGM's Empire City Casino in Yonkers and Genting's Resorts World New York in Queens are considered strong front-runners to obtain full casino licenses from the New York Gaming Commission. Here's why they both have a high likelihood: Key Advantages for Both MGM and Genting: * Existing "Racino" Operations: Both properties already operate as "racinos" with video lottery terminals (VLTs) and electronic table games. This means they have established infrastructure, a customer base, and a proven track record of generating significant tax revenue for the state. Converting to full casinos would be a much faster process than building a new facility from scratch. * Community Support: Both MGM and Resorts World have existing ties to their communities and generally face limited opposition to their bids. In fact, local officials, like Yonkers Mayor Mike Spano, have publicly advocated for their immediate licensing, citing the economic benefits. Community Advisory Committees (CACs) must approve projects, and their existing community relationships are a major advantage. * "Shovel Ready" Status: As existing facilities, they are essentially "shovel ready" to expand their offerings to include live dealer table games and other full casino amenities, allowing for quicker generation of tax revenue and jobs. * Economic Benefits: Both companies have pledged substantial investments and increased tax contributions if awarded full licenses. MGM has committed to creating 2,500 jobs, and Resorts World has plans for a $5 billion investment and a commitment to help construct 50,000 middle-income housing units, aligning with state priorities. * Market Consensus: Industry analysts and market consensus generally view MGM Empire City and Resorts World as likely winners for two of the three available downstate licenses. Factors to Consider: * Competition: While they are frontrunners, there are other bidders for the three downstate licenses, and the competition is fierce. However, some major bidders have recently dropped out, further solidifying the positions of MGM and Genting. * Timeline: The New York State Gaming Commission has indicated that the licenses are not expected to be awarded until December 2025. * Evaluation Criteria: The Gaming Facility Location Board will evaluate applications based on factors including economic activity and business development (70%), local impact siting (10%), workforce enhancement (10%), and diversity framework (10%). Both MGM and Genting are actively showcasing how they meet these criteria. In conclusion, it's highly probable that both MGM and Genting Resorts World New York will obtain full casino licenses. Their existing operations, community support, and significant economic contributions give them a considerable advantage in the competitive New York market.

author: Joe18
body: Genting Malaysia Berhad (GENM), through its subsidiary Empire Resorts Inc, has entered into a significant agreement with the Sullivan County Resort Facilities Local Development Corporation (SCRFLDC) concerning its non-gaming assets in New York. The arrangement is a part of a larger plan to restructure and strengthen Empire Resorts' financial position. Here are the key details of the arrangement: 1. Disposal of Non-Gaming Assets: * Empire Resorts will sell its non-gaming assets to SCRFLDC for US$525 million (approximately RM2.2 billion). * These assets include: * The 332-room Resorts World Catskills (RWC) hotel. * The 99-room Alder Hotel. * The 18-hole Monster Golf Course. * The 2,500-seat RWC Epicenter. * Multiple restaurants. 2. Management Agreement: * Following the sale, Empire Resorts will enter into a 20-year management agreement with SCRFLDC to continue managing all the non-gaming assets it just sold. * This management agreement includes an automatic renewal for two successive five-year periods, extending the potential management period. 3. Land Lease: * Simultaneously, Empire Resorts will enter into a land lease with SCRFLDC for all the land on which these non-gaming assets are built. * The land lease agreement will be in effect until February 15, 2066. 4. Use of Proceeds: * The proceeds from the disposal of the non-gaming assets will be used to: * Purchase 1,554.6 acres of land from a real estate investment trust (EPR Properties) for US$201.3 million (RM848.1 million). This acquisition is intended to strengthen Genting Malaysia's asset base and provide long-term control over the land where the RWC's gaming and non-gaming facilities are located, as well as vacant land for future development. * Redeem US$300 million (RM1.3 billion) in 7.75% senior unsecured notes due in November 2026, which will make Empire Resorts debt-free. * Fund working capital needs, generating about US$10 million (RM42.1 million) in surplus cash for general working capital. This strategic move allows Genting Malaysia to offload non-gaming assets while retaining operational control and strengthening its financial and competitive position in the New York market.

author: ImCK
body: they’re showing their cards to the market. This isn’t liability its GEM .Once the market realizes this is a strategy — not a liability — it will generate stronger confidence and re-rate Genting’s valuation. Hopefully, Genting can optimize its assets with a similar strategy. Sunway is a good example: they sold heavy assets into their REIT, using market money for upkeep and maintenance while still expanding. This way, they recycle capital, keep the balance sheet lighter, and continue growing. If Genting (the parent) does something like Sunway — moving heavy assets into a REIT or similar structure — then: Parent company no longer books depreciation on those transferred assets. That means reported profit looks cleaner, closer to real operating profit instead of being dragged down by non-cash depreciation charges. At the same time, upkeep/maintenance is funded by market money (via REIT investors), not eating into Genting’s own cash flow. Genting still benefits by collecting recurring income (rental/management fees) while freeing up capital for expansion.

author: ImCK
body: GENM should have pursued a REIT IPO much earlier to leverage market capital for expansion and infrastructure. By placing heavy assets into a REIT, GENM could recycle capital, reduce depreciation drag, and let the market fund upkeep and growth. This would allow GENM itself to focus on light-asset strategies — gaming, entertainment, digital, and brand experiences — while still benefiting from recurring income through the REIT.

author: Calvin2025
body: The general options available to a retail shareholder in a takeover bid like this are: Accept the Offer (Sell your shares): You can choose to accept Genting Berhad's offer of RM2.35 cash per share. This is an attractive option if you believe the price offers a good premium and you want a certain cash exit now, especially since the offer is at a premium to the market price before the announcement. Action: Follow the instructions provided in the formal offer document (which will be mailed to you) to submit your acceptance form to the offeror's receiving agent. Reject the Offer (Do nothing): You can choose to reject the offer and hold onto your shares. The consequences of this depend on the outcome of the takeover: If Genting gains more than 90% ownership: Genting will likely exercise its right to compulsorily acquire the remaining shares. In this case, your shares will be bought out at the offer price of RM2.35 (or a price determined by a process that may involve the courts if the price is disputed), and the company will be delisted. Your shares will still be converted to cash, but later. If Genting gains more than 50% but less than 90% (and the public shareholding spread falls below 25%): Genting has stated it does not intend to maintain the listing status if the public shareholding spread falls below the required 25%. If delisting occurs, your shares will become shares in an unlisted company. This makes them difficult to trade, and the valuation of the unlisted shares may become opaque. If the offer fails (Genting does not meet the condition to own more than 50%): The offer lapses, and the company remains listed. The share price would likely revert to a level reflecting its fundamentals before the takeover was announced. Sell Your Shares on the Open Market: You can sell your shares on the stock exchange (Bursa Malaysia) during the offer period, provided the stock is trading. If the market price rises to RM2.35 or slightly below, selling on the open market provides immediate liquidity without needing to fill out acceptance forms. However, the price is subject to market fluctuation and may be slightly lower than the offer price due to transaction costs.

author: StakesAreHigh
body: Maybank Investment Bank (Maybank IB) said the offer price “undervalues GENM” and fails to reflect several key catalysts that could materially lift its fair value (FV). For starters, the revaluation of its Miami land, acquired in 2011 for US$442 million (RM1.87 billion) will add 55 sen to its FV. It noted that GENM had attempted to sell it at a market value of US$1.2 billion (RM5.07 billion) in 2023. The second catalyst is the potential sale of its US subsidiary Empire Resorts’ non-gaming assets to the Sullivan County Resort Facilities Local Development Corp, which could add 30 sen to its fair value. GENM announced last month that Empire Resorts is disposing of its non-casino properties in New York state for US$525 million (RM2.2 billion) to eliminate its debt, and purchase land. The third catalyst is the potential award of a downstate commercial casino licence in New York, which could boost value by 48 sen per share after a 10% discount. The award results are expected by Dec 1, 2025. TA Securities advised shareholders to reject the offer, noting it is not in the best interest of the Genting group to delist GENM given its future fundraising needs. “This is particularly relevant to GENM’s plan to spend US$5.5 billion (RM23.25 billion) to elevate RWNYC (Resorts World New York City) if it wins the New York casino licence,” it said in a note today. TA also said that achieving the 75% acceptance threshold required for privatisation could prove difficult, given Genting’s “unattractive offer price”.

author: Linewalker95
body: Let's calculate this step-by-step. We know from the original announcement: GENT's initial stake: 49.36% Total number of GENM shares: 2.87 billion shares / 50.64% (the portion they don't own). This means the total issued shares of GENM = 2.87 billion / 0.5064 = **approximately **5.667 billion shares****. From the new announcement on 14 Oct 2025: GENT bought an additional 9,000,000 shares. 1. Calculate New Number of Shares Held First, find the initial number of shares GENT held: Initial Shares Held = 49.36% of 5.667 billion = 0.4936 * 5,667,000,000 = 2,796,000,000 shares (approximately). Now add the new shares they bought: New Total Shares Held = 2,796,000,000 + 9,000,000 = 2,805,000,000 shares. 2. Calculate New Percentage New Percentage = (New Total Shares Held / Total Issued Shares) * 100 = (2,805,000,000 / 5,667,000,000) * 100 = 49.49%.

author: Michael Lee
body: （Genting Berhad）@2026年度超级股票 🌟 1️⃣ 历史证明一切 @ 成功模式再度上演 在云顶赢得圣淘沙综合度假村（Resorts World Sentosa）牌照之前，集团曾经成功私有化云顶新加坡（Genting Singapore），以便集中资源、统一决策，赢取最终胜利。 如今相同的布局正在重演——云顶集团已全面准备，几乎笃定拿下纽约州全赌场牌照。 历史告诉我们：每当云顶在重大里程碑前完成整合或私有化，股价必将迎来巨大重估。 2️⃣ 云顶大马@稳定现金牛，集团核心支柱 云顶马来西亚（Genting Malaysia Berhad, GENM）仍是集团的现金引擎， 凭借稳定的EBITDA与强劲的自由现金流，支撑集团的全球扩张。 疫情后业绩强劲复苏，一旦进行结构重组或重新上市，将释放数十亿令吉的潜在资产价值，为母公司云顶集团带来显著增值。 3️⃣ 美国资产整合 @ “Genting USA” 即将诞生 云顶有望将旗下所有美国赌场资产——包括 Resorts World New York City、Resorts World Hudson Valley 与 Resorts World Las Vegas—— 整合成一个统一平台，成立 “Genting USA”。 未来更可能在美国道琼斯或纳斯达克上市， 让云顶集团直接对接全球资本市场，与 Las Vegas Sands、MGM Resorts 等国际巨头平起平坐。 4️⃣ 英国版图扩张 @ 隐藏的价值宝藏 鲜为人知的是，云顶在 2025年已完成多项英国赌场收购，低调地扩大欧洲版图。 未来极可能将英国所有资产整合为 “Genting UK”， 并计划在 伦敦证券交易所（LSE） 上市， 让云顶在欧洲的估值与曝光度全面提升。 5️⃣ 马来西亚业务重组 @“新云顶马来西亚” 或将登场 集团有望将马来西亚境内的赌场、酒店与娱乐产业重组整合为 “新云顶马来西亚（New Genting Malaysia）”， 并重新在 马股主板（Bursa Malaysia） 上市。 此举将重新评估并释放长期被低估的核心资产价值， 同时吸引更多国际资金关注马来西亚旗舰业务。 6️⃣ Taurex 项目 @ 2026年重大催化 备受瞩目的 Taurex 生命科技项目 预计将在 2026年获得全面审批， 标志着云顶正式进军 生物科技与健康创新领域。 这不仅提升集团的 ESG形象， 也为云顶带来更高成长性与利润率的新产业支柱。 7️⃣ 发电资产上市 @ 基础设施价值释放 云顶集团旗下的发电与能源资产长期被低估， 一旦分拆或独立上市，将释放数十亿潜在市值， 确立云顶作为区域性能源基础设施龙头的地位。 8️⃣ 能源业务扩展 @ FLNG 发展潜力巨大 集团的 浮式液化天然气（FLNG）项目 是能源板块的关键突破， 预计投产后将带来稳定的美元计价收入， 进一步强化云顶的全球能源布局与盈利多元化。 9️⃣ 迈阿密土地变现 @巨额现金回流 云顶持有美国迈阿密市中心极具价值的海滨地块， 未来通过出售或合作开发，有望实现 约RM4至5亿令吉（约10亿美元）资金回笼， 大幅降低集团负债比并增强现金流。 🔟 Empire Resorts 非核心资产剥离 旗下 Empire Resorts Inc.（帝国度假村） 预计在 2026年第二季度 完成 非核心资产处置。 届时 Empire 预计将实现零负债及稳健盈利， 为未来纳入 “Genting USA” 整合平台铺平道路。 💎 结论：2026 —— 云顶集团的重生之年 随着多个全球级催化剂陆续到来： 纽约州全赌场牌照 美国与英国双地上市计划 Taurex 项目核准 能源与发电业务上市 迈阿密与帝国资产变现 云顶集团正迈入历史性的价值重估周期。 📈 一切迹象清晰表明： > 云顶集团（Genting Berhad）必将成为2026年度的 No.1 超级股票！
